name: Smash ladder
summary: An Elo ladder for a game the group plays, built from who beat who; log a set and the ratings move and rows re-sort.
useWhen: a chat that keeps arguing who is best at a game: 'gg i won', 'run it back', 'I'm the best here'
dontUseWhen: one game's score right now (use a scoreboard)
a streak or daily habit (use gym)

params.title: string
params.logged: how many results were found in the chat
params.wins: n x n sets row beat column
